payload.contribution: sum over the family's sites of (|e_S| - |e_D|) divided by all 1726 sites; the contributions add up to the pooled A
payload.estimator: pooled seed-ensemble out-of-fold predictions (seeds 0-2); dftgnn.stats.g1.HierDraws with one resample over the hosts of the set (2000, seed 20261008), as in scripts/analysis/ingest_m1_recompute.loco; per-fold, per-family-removed and greedy bounds are new draws of the same estimator on the reduced host set (descriptive)
payload.family_key_definition: S02 definition ii-a: sorted tuple of the distinct periodic-table groups of the host's non-oxygen elements, lanthanides and actinides counted as group 3, written as groups joined by '-' (e.g. '2-14' for Sr2SnO4)
payload.fold_rule: sklearn.model_selection.GroupKFold(n_splits=5), no shuffling, hosts sorted by host_id
payload.label: DERIVED (C1); descriptive, no test
